Saneagle 500W Electric Bike: Power, Range, and Reliability for Outdoor Rides

⚠️ Safety & Compliance Notice: Max Speed: 20 MPH | Recommended Age: 18+ | This e-bike is designed for recreational and trail use only. Always wear a helmet and check local regulations before riding.

1. 1000W Peak Motor: Effortless Acceleration & Hill Climbing

Equipped with a 500W rated brushless motor (1000W peak assist), this electric bike delivers smooth, responsive power. It easily conquers steep hills and rough terrain, making every ride feel effortless. Perfect for gravel paths, dirt trails, and outdoor exploration.

2. 52V 15Ah UL 2849-Certified Battery: Long-Lasting Performance

Powered by a high-capacity 52V 15Ah removable lithium battery, this e-bike offers reliable range for all-day rides. Fully charged in just 5-6 hours, it delivers up to 70 miles in pedal-assist mode and 35 miles in pure electric mode. UL 2849 certified for safety and peace of mind.

3. Shimano 21-Speed & 26" All-Terrain Tires: Smooth, Versatile Riding

The professional Shimano 21-speed transmission ensures seamless gear shifting for any trail condition. Paired with 26-inch puncture-resistant tires, front suspension fork, and dual disc brakes, you’ll enjoy stable, comfortable, and controlled rides on every adventure.

4. Sturdy Build & Practical Features

The durable aluminum frame supports a max load of 330 lbs, built to withstand daily outdoor use. Integrated headlight, rear rack, and fenders add extra convenience for your rides. The intuitive LCD display shows real-time speed, battery level, and mileage at a glance.

5. Easy Assembly & Full Support

The bike arrives 85% pre-assembled for quick setup. Package includes battery, charger, tool kit, and detailed English manual. Our responsive after-sales team is here to assist with installation, maintenance, and usage questions. Please keep the original packaging and all accessories intact if you need to return the item.
